lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of approximately circular high-luminance clusters organized into distinct longitudinal rows. These clusters exhibit higher contrast and more defined boundaries in the mid-flank region located between the primary and secondary carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like pattern where high-intensity spots are frequently positioned at these intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal aspect and significant shadowing on the ventral aspect, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible anterior portion of the first dorsal fin displays a dense distribution of small, high-luminance blobs against a darker substrate, though the posterior segment is occluded.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes swimming in close proximity to the ventral midline, consistent with commensal fish.
